info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Fluoride Syrup Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Fluoride Syrup Catalog Management API allows businesses to effectively manage details related to fluoride syrup products. This API provides functionalities to create and update product specifications, ensuring that all information is consistent and comprehensive. Ideal for product managers and inventory systems, it supports use cases involving the addition of new fluoride syrup variants and updates to existing product details. By utilizing this API, organizations can maintain a robust catalog that meets regulatory standards and consumer needs.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create and store details for fluoride syrup, ensuring proper tracking and management of syrup formulations.

requestBody.description: A request to submit details for fluoride syrup. The request body must adhere to the specified JSON schema.

200.description: The request was processed successfully, and the response includes the requested information.

requestedBy.description: Name of the person requesting the fluoride syrup.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is of high priority.

unitPrice.description: Price per unit of the fluoride syrup.

CreateCatalogFluorideSyrupDetailRequest.description: Schema representing a request for fluoride syrup details, including relevant metadata like quantity, price, and requestor information.
